# CashInstinct

> Bilingual (FR/EN) Canadian referral hub. This file is a short summary of the maintained pages below, not an independent source of program terms. Each guide carries its own conditions, regional limits, verification date, and paused/active status; promotions and provider terms can change.

CashInstinct publishes bilingual guides, comparisons, and independent tools. Use the linked page as the source for the current details, eligibility, conditions, and disclosures. Site: https://cashinstinct.ca — Répertoire bilingue de guides et de codes de parrainage au Canada.

llms.txt synchronization audit: August 17, 2026 / Audit de synchronisation de llms.txt : 17 août 2026

## Referral codes / Codes de parrainage

- [Sticker Mule — code CASHINSTINCT](https://www.stickermule.com/ca/unlock?ref_id=6042474701): The current guide documents referral credit as the first-order method; no standard public coupon field appeared in the August 8, 2026 checkout check. The regional credit is $12.50 CAD / $10 USD / €9 / £8, with regional minimum-order conditions. Guides: [EN](https://cashinstinct.ca/stickermule/en/) · [FR](https://cashinstinct.ca/stickermule/fr/)
- [EBOX — code GE911](https://cashinstinct.ca/ebox/fr/): GE911 gives a $25 credit on the second invoice for eligible Fibre service. The guide separately documents a temporary $100 digital prepaid card for eligible new Quebec/Ontario customers on 500 Mbps or 1 Gbps Fibre, from August 10 through September 6, 2026. The card terms say it cannot be combined with other offers or promotions; GE911 is a separate referral mechanism, so review EBOX's current terms before treating the benefits as combinable. The guide may describe up to $125 in combined value, without guaranteeing it. Guides: [FR](https://cashinstinct.ca/ebox/fr/) · [EN](https://cashinstinct.ca/ebox/en/)
- [HP Instant Ink — friend code SVdn7](https://try.hpinstantink.com/SVdn7): The current public referral flow offers 1 free month via friend code SVdn7. The guide reports Canada-wide availability and no fixed public expiry in its August 8, 2026 check; HP may change or disable the offer. Guides: [EN](https://cashinstinct.ca/hp-instant-ink/en/) · [FR](https://cashinstinct.ca/hp-instant-ink/fr/)
- [Tangerine — Orange Key 28709877S1](https://cashinstinct.ca/tangerine/fr/): The guide currently distinguishes three separate programs: a $50 Orange Key bonus requiring a $250 balance maintained for 60 consecutive days; a separate $250 chequing offer requiring at least $200 per month in qualifying payroll deposits for two consecutive months, with the current window ending October 31, 2026; and a savings offer currently stated as 4.50% non-registered or 5.00% registered for 153 days, for eligible client numbers created July 28 through November 30, 2026. Any combination is conditional on each offer's terms; recheck the guide after the dated windows. Guides: [FR](https://cashinstinct.ca/tangerine/fr/) · [EN](https://cashinstinct.ca/tangerine/en/)
- [Chexy — referral link](https://chexy.app.link/REF-WDTW5Q): The authenticated Chexy dashboard captured August 13, 2026 displays “Give $20, Get $20” once the referred friend schedules a first payment. The 2026 Help Centre guide uses “complete” and mentions the mobile app; the guide keeps this source wording difference explicit. There is no referral-code field at account creation; a separate promo-code field can exist later at payment. Chexy's August 17, 2026 announcement says the Scotia Momentum Visa Infinite+ will earn 1% rather than 4% from October 22 on rent, household expenses, condo/strata fees, property tax and income tax; it is therefore not a generic optimal example for those categories at the 1.75% base fee, but this does not make Chexy broadly unprofitable because other cards may still earn 2% or 3% depending on category and conditions. Guides: [EN](https://cashinstinct.ca/chexy/en/) · [FR](https://cashinstinct.ca/chexy/fr/)
- [Rakuten Canada — referral link](https://www.rakuten.ca/r/cashinstinct?src=Link): The current guide states a $30 CAD cashback welcome bonus through the referral link after a first qualifying purchase. It reports availability in all provinces, including Quebec; amount and terms remain subject to the current Rakuten flow. Guides: [EN](https://cashinstinct.ca/rakuten-canada/en/) · [FR](https://cashinstinct.ca/rakuten-canada/fr/)
- [Swagbucks — referral link](https://www.swagbucks.com/profile/Cashinstinct?rp=1): The current guide states a $10 (1,000 SB) welcome SwagUp through the referral link, unlocked by one qualifying Shop purchase of at least $25 that generates at least 25 SB within 30 days. Cash Instinct can receive a separate 300 SB referrer bonus when the referral earns 300 eligible SB within the first 30 days, subject to availability; the older official article saying both people receive 300 SB remains relevant only to the new member's own 300 SB. Guides: [EN](https://cashinstinct.ca/swagbucks/en/) · [FR](https://cashinstinct.ca/swagbucks/fr/)

## Paused / En pause

- [Achieva Financial — Petal Code V381566198](https://cashinstinct.ca/achieva/fr/): Achieva's referral program is paused for improvements, with a return announced for summer 2026 but no confirmed new terms. The old $25 amount and code V381566198 are historical references only and are not a current claim; the relaunch amount, code, conditions, and entry route remain to be verified. Account opening is still available online or in the mobile app. Guides: [FR](https://cashinstinct.ca/achieva/fr/) · [EN](https://cashinstinct.ca/achieva/en/)

## Guides / Guides pédagogiques

- [FTTH vs HFC vs FTTN — fibre, câble ou DSL](https://cashinstinct.ca/ftth-vs-hfc-vs-fttn/en/): Neutral evergreen guide to fixed-access technologies in Canada. It contains no prices, plans, referral codes, or provider promotion; it explains the last-mile distinction and the limits of claims about upload, ping, Wi-Fi, and real-world experience. Guides: [EN](https://cashinstinct.ca/ftth-vs-hfc-vs-fttn/en/) · [FR](https://cashinstinct.ca/ftth-vs-hfc-vs-fttn/fr/)
- [The Real Value of a Promotion / Valeur réelle d’une promotion](https://cashinstinct.ca/valeur-reelle-promotion-canada/fr/): A bilingual methodology guide based on documented Canadian case studies. It distinguishes announced value, usable value, real value, incremental costs and eligibility conditions; it is not a provider ranking, referral-code list or calculator. Guides: [FR](https://cashinstinct.ca/valeur-reelle-promotion-canada/fr/) · [EN](https://cashinstinct.ca/real-value-canadian-promotion/en/)

## Comparison guides / Comparatifs

Independent comparison pages. Referral codes appear only where CashInstinct is a member of the program. Prices and availability are snapshots and must be rechecked against the current provider flow.

- [EBOX vs Fizz vs oxio — Quebec internet 2026](https://cashinstinct.ca/ebox-vs-fizz-vs-oxio/en/): Side-by-side comparison of three budget internet providers in Quebec: monthly prices, download/upload speeds, installation fees, contract terms, and referral programs. Editorially revised and rechecked August 7, 2026; oxio examples and other provider details are address- and date-dependent. Guides: [EN](https://cashinstinct.ca/ebox-vs-fizz-vs-oxio/en/) · [FR](https://cashinstinct.ca/ebox-vs-fizz-vs-oxio/fr/)
- [EBOX vs Bell vs Videotron — Quebec internet 2026](https://cashinstinct.ca/ebox-vs-bell-vs-videotron/en/): Comparison of EBOX with Bell and Videotron. The current snapshot lists EBOX at $49/$55/$65, Bell limited-time promotional prices that may increase during the subscription, and Videotron cable service with upload and discount conditions that vary by address and offer. Only EBOX carries referral code GE911; Bell and Videotron links are non-affiliate. Revised and rechecked August 7, 2026. Guides: [EN](https://cashinstinct.ca/ebox-vs-bell-vs-videotron/en/) · [FR](https://cashinstinct.ca/ebox-vs-bell-vs-videotron/fr/)

## Tools / Outils

Independent tools with no referral relationship or commission — informational only.

- [Points Value Calculator / Calculatrice de valeur des points](https://cashinstinct.ca/valeur-points/fr/): Free bilingual calculator covering 13 Canadian points programs — Amex Membership Rewards, Aeroplan, RBC Avion, Avios, Marriott Bonvoy, BMO Blue Rewards, BNC À la carte, TD Rewards, Scene+, PC Optimum, BMO Rewards, MBNA, and CIBC Aventura. Values vary by program and redemption mode; the page distinguishes official rates, catalogue rates, and editorial estimates. Terms and estimates were revalidated August 7, 2026. No affiliate link, code, or commission. Guides: [FR](https://cashinstinct.ca/valeur-points/fr/) · [EN](https://cashinstinct.ca/valeur-points/en/)
- [Internet Real Cost Calculator / Calculateur de coût Internet réel](https://cashinstinct.ca/internet-cout-reel/fr/): Bilingual calculator for comparing two Canadian home Internet offers over 12, 24, 36 months or a custom period. Users enter their own promotional price, regular price, one-time fees and credits or gift cards; the monthly price should include any equipment charge. No provider prices are prefilled. It reports total net cost, effective monthly cost and post-promotion price without an arbitrary score. It is a mathematical tool, not a provider recommendation, and carries no affiliate link, code or commission. Guides: [FR](https://cashinstinct.ca/internet-cout-reel/fr/) · [EN](https://cashinstinct.ca/internet-real-cost/en/)
- [Refundable Hotel Trick (RHT) — guide canadien](https://cashinstinct.ca/rht/fr/): Neutral practical guide comparing the timing, rate, and critical step for six Canadian rewards programs. The RHT is a community method, not a bank-documented or guaranteed cash-out method; official rules are cited where available, and the page warns that programs can change and users assume the risk. Guides: [FR](https://cashinstinct.ca/rht/fr/) · [EN](https://cashinstinct.ca/rht/en/)
